label: Q-switched Nd:YAG (850 mJ)
tooltip: Quantel/Lumibird Q-smart 850 flashlamp Nd:YAG: 850 mJ/pulse, ~6 ns FWHM, 10 Hz, 9 mm beam, horizontal polarization >80% (Quantel datasheet 10-32-2667 rev 05/14; linewidth <=0.7 cm^-1 — modelled monochromatic). Average power derives as 8.5 W; peak power 133 MW.
